summary: The `ClientOnly` functional Vue component (from the vue-ClientOnly package used by Nuxt). Until its parent is mounted it renders either a placeholder element (tag from the `placeholderTag` prop, default `div`, with class `.client-only-placeholder`, content from the `placeholder` prop or the `placeholder` slot) or empty comment nodes; it registers a one-time `hook:mounted` listener on the parent that calls `$forceUpdate()`, after which the default slot content is rendered client-side.
